index.hero_p1: Upload your lecture PDF and get a summary and flashcards, ready to go.
index.hero_p2: Review on the right day, before you forget, with spaced repetition.
index.passo1_p: Give each course a name and a color. Everything you upload stays organized there.
index.passo2_p: A PDF with selectable text, up to 10 MB. Then ask for a summary, flashcards, or both.
index.passo3_p: Every day you get the cards you are about to forget. You rate how it went and the next interval adjusts.
index.aviso_ia: Summaries and flashcards are generated by AI and may contain mistakes. Use them as support and check against the original material.
index.rec1_p: Each course with its PDFs, summaries and flashcards, in the color you choose.
index.rec2_p: The key points of the PDF as bullet points, plus questions ready to practice.
index.rec3_p: The SM-2 algorithm decides when each card comes back. Streaks and levels keep the habit going.
index.rec4_p: Practice tests per subject and a leaderboard with friends.
index.gratis_itens:
• 20 AI generations per month
  • Unlimited flashcards and reviews
  • Unlimited subjects
  • Export and delete your data
index.pro_itens:
• 300 AI generations every 30 days
  • Everything in Free
  • Priority generation
  • Card or Pix, no automatic renewal
index.nota_geracao: A “generation” is each summary or set of flashcards created from a PDF. Uploading PDFs, reviewing cards and reading summaries do not use generations.
index.faq1_r: We don't keep the original file. We extract the text, use it to generate the summary and flashcards, and store that text encrypted in your account.
index.faq2_p: Can anyone besides me see my materials?
index.faq2_r: Each piece of content is only accessible to the account that created it. To generate summaries and flashcards, the text is sent to the AI provider, which processes it to return the result. The details are in the Privacy Policy.
index.faq3_r: Yes. Summaries and cards are a study aid and don't replace the original material or your teacher. It's worth double-checking important points before the exam.
index.faq4_p: Does it work with scanned or password-protected PDFs?
index.faq4_r: Not yet. The PDF needs selectable text. Scanned files (images only) and password-protected PDFs can't be read. The limit is 10 MB and 300 pages per file.
index.faq5_r: It means reviewing content at growing intervals: what you know well shows up less and less often, and what you get wrong comes back soon. That way you spend time where you need it.
index.faq6_r: Yes. In “My account” you can download a copy of everything and delete your account and all your content whenever you want.
index.faq7_r: You choose card or Pix and pay in Mercado Pago's secure checkout. Studiy never sees or stores your card details. Pro lasts 30 days and doesn't renew on its own.
index.priv_itens:
• Passwords stored only as hashes, never in plain text
  • Texts, summaries and flashcards encrypted at rest
  • Encrypted connection (HTTPS) in production
  • Export a copy of your data or delete your account whenever you want
